item.title: Import KeyCloak Configuration via CI/CD
item.description:
In a research project, we recently introduced the identity and access management system KeyCloak into our prototype. Since we want to deploy this setup to multiple servers (acceptance and production environments) we thought about how to transfer the KeyCloak Real Settings (Email SMTP configuration, clients, etc.) from one environment to the next. This has 3 main advantages:

  • save the time to enter the same settings again, that were already tested
  • avoid mistakes when recreating those settings
  • have the base Keycloak realm settings under version control

item.title: Restore large MongoDB backup in Docker Desktop
item.description:
Recently, I wanted to restore a MongoDB backup of a bigger production database locally for testing.

The container was created with a standard docker run command: docker run -d -p 27017:27017 -v {PATH_TO_FOLDER}:/data-test -e MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME=admin -e MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD=admin --name test-mongo mongo:4.4.3.

item.title: Using Marp-CLI in a Docker container
item.description: Recently, I had the idea for a tool, that converts a CSV file into a Marp markdown slides, which can subsequently be converted into a pdf file. The goal was to be able to work on multiple-choice quizzes with friends using e.g. google docs, then export the sheet as CSV and quickly generate slides for a quiz night.
